**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 421

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
Most movement in a game can be represented on a flat map. If creatures are flying, swimming, or otherwise moving through three-dimensional space, see the advice on page 437 under Special Battles.
</column>
